cadence_anchor: scheduled market end, backward in fixed 30-second steps
snapshot_rule: At each decision time use the latest same-token capture at or before that time, never after; require valid two-sided uncrossed/unlocked book and nonnegative age no greater than 15 seconds.

history.unit: distinct preceding captured books for same token, including decision book
history.common_endpoint_rule: All P0-P4 arms score identical opportunities with complete eligible history

features.market_probability: midpoint of best bid and ask
features.history: the same ten current-state features at eight causally preceding captures, with age-in-seconds per history element; flatten the identical array for P3, preserve sequence for P4

primary_contrast: P3_history_XGBoost versus P4_GRU on final markets; both also versus P0
selection_rule: Tune within train/dev only; no final outcomes or final model scores before code, features, cadence, hyperparameters and comparison are frozen
limits: Four UTC dates and partial final day; any result remains a narrow pilot.
